Data stories · the grammar’s forms

A gallery of forms

Fourteen forms, each drawn by packages/shared/src/stories from real UN rows, in the plate, the key and the colours every story uses. Every label is placed against the marks; none collide at either width.

I
Lines

lines

Change over time, with every other member for shape, the source’s projection dashed and its ranges hatched, references and named zones; one or more panels on one time axis.

II
Swarm

swarm

Every member placed at the moment something happened to it, sized by its weight; a step panel above on the same time scale. The fold-out form.

III
Heatmap

heatmap

A value for every member and every year at once, on a diverging ramp turned on a meaningful midpoint; members grouped and ordered by when something happened.

IV
Map

map

A value for every country, binned on the same ramp; India drawn as India depicts its boundaries; no data in quiet grey.

V
Scatter

scatter

Two measures together, each circle a member sized by its weight, the members the words name labelled on the plot.

VI
Trail

trail

How a few members moved through two measures over time: a path each, a dot every ten years, the projection dashed.

VII
Ridgeline

ridgeline

How a distribution shifts: one density a moment on one height scale, its median marked, the projected moment hatched.

VIII
Slope

slope

Change between two moments for a dozen or so members, labels spread so none collide.

IX
Dumbbell

dumbbell

Two values for each member, then (a ring) and now (a dot), sorted by now.

X
Bars

bars

Amounts ranked, from zero, values at the tips, a reference where the words need one.

XI
Bump

bump

Rankings over time: ranks worked out by code among the members shown, names at both ends.

XII
Multiples

multiples

The same measure for a few members on one shared scale, each against a grey reference.

XIII
Stack

stack

Shares of a whole over time, adding to 100, the projected years hatched.

XIV
Pyramid

pyramid

A population by age and sex, now in the ink and a later year as a silhouette over it.
